Connectable SERIES are stated on the Panasonic UK Free Multi System Z page (Etherea, TZ wall, floor console, slim ducted, 4-way 60x60 cassette) and the AT Free Multi page lists CS-Z..CKEW / CS-XZ..CKEW / CS-TZ..CKEW (incl. 7.1 kW) as Free Multi indoor units. openQuestions: Outdoor SOUND POWER (LwA) for CU-Z..CKE, CU-TZ..CKE and CU-xZ..CBE was not found (Panasonic web tables give sound pressure only). Pull EPREL product fiches (EU energy label database) or the PDF datasheet; the older ZKE generation fiche showed 61/62 dB(A) for CU-Z25ZKE but that must not be reused for CKE.

Official Panasonic Free Multi combination table not retrieved: per-port maximum indoor size, whether 7.1 kW wall units are allowed on each outdoor, and which pipe reducers/expanders (CZ-MA1PA / CZ-MA2PA / CZ-MA3PA) are needed for 5.0 kW (1/2" gas) and 7.1 kW (5/8" gas) indoor units. connectableIndoorModels in compatibility[] is derived from capacity ranges and must be confirmed.

Warranty: does the up-to-7-year PRO Partner warranty apply to residential air-to-air (RAC) splits or only Aquarea? What does 'Dang, It's Hot' need (Accredited Installer training, PRO Club registration) to offer 5 years? Current UK warranty document (rev R2, 1 Dec 2021) and PHVAC UK T&Cs (1 Dec 2023) were not opened.

Generation/availability: Panasonic UK pages now list the CKE generation (Etherea CS-Z..CKEW, TZ CS-TZ..CKEW) and CBE Free Multi outdoors, but a 2025/2026 UK distributor price list still shows TBE Free Multi codes and some UK distributors still stock ZKE (2023) units. Confirm with the chosen UK distributor which suffixes are actually shippable for the pilot installs.
Some Panasonic GB listings title 'KIT-Z25-CKE' / 'KIT-Z50-CKE' with the silver CS-XZ indoor rather than white CS-Z; confirm the exact UK kit SKUs and colour codes when ordering.
Etherea 7.1 kW cooling operating range and maximum heating ambient, and TZ 7.1 kW operating range maximums, were not captured.

Indoor weight conflicts on Panasonic pages (TZ71 15 kg vs 13 kg; standalone TZ indoor pages showing outdoor weights). Kit-table values used; verify from installation manual for bracket/wall-fixing planning.

Recommended breaker values are Panasonic's 'recommended fuse' ratings; MCB curve type (the older French TZ datasheet specified curve D, 16 A) and cable sizing for UK BS 7671 installs should be confirmed from the UK installation manual.

Multi TZ outdoor range (CU-2TZ41TBE, CU-2TZ50TBE, CU-3TZ52TBE - a cheaper TZ-focused multi, e.g. CU-2TZ50TBE SEER 7.00 / SCOP 4.20, 3.2-7.7 kW) appears on the Panasonic multi-split selector but was not catalogued; check UK availability, CBE successor and price versus Free Multi Z.
Heating capacities above are nominal (+7 C outdoor). For UK heat-loss sizing use the -7 C / -2 C capacity tables from the technical databook (only some -7 C values captured in notes).
